scenes.vo: Một lá Gengar được trả năm trăm bảy mươi sáu nghìn đô la,
scenes.gloss: A Gengar card was bid to five hundred seventy-six thousand dollars,
scenes.viewer: The hammer falls: $576,000 on the Gengar.
scenes.build: new: the hall stage, rostrum with sound block, lot plinth with the Gengar slab and the tag arm, price board, bid counter, FANATICS COLLECT letters.
scenes.blocking: Auctioneer behind the rostrum (auct mark, on the stage), gavel raised in his right arm (screen left) from f0.
scenes.action: f0-70 the board counts the last steps up to $576,000 (in time with 'năm trăm bảy mươi sáu'); f70-76 wind-up of the gavel, held at the top f73-76; f79 the gavel slams the block (2 f before 'đô' f81): the board snaps to $576,000 with the red SOLD lamp; f80 the tag drops 15 cm out of its brass holder on its string and swings (damped pendulum, 4 swings) showing SOLD $576,000; f84-100 glide down to the slab and the swinging tag.
scenes.acting: Auctioneer: a showman's grin; on the slam his eyes shut tight.

cams.why: the board over the rostrum and the lot
push to the slab and the tag

marks.pose: standing; gavel wind-up f70-76, slam f79

scenes.physics: tag: pendulum on a 13 cm string, released at f80 from 15 cm up: drops, snaps taut, swings ±25 deg damped (settles by f130). Gavel: 1 f strike, 2 f squash of the block.
scenes.light_mood: warm auction light, the board glow.
scenes.sound: crowd murmur; gavel crack f79; a ka-ching f81; the tag string snap f80; the score's first hit.
scenes.after: The tag hangs from its string: SOLD $576,000.

scenes.vo: và hôm sau, nó bị đánh dấu là chưa thanh toán. Đúng chất Pokémon hệ ma: có đó, rồi biến mất.
scenes.gloss: and the next day it was marked unpaid. Typical ghost-type Pokémon: there, then gone.
scenes.viewer: Next day the tag flips to CHƯA THANH TOÁN, then ghosts away.

out.note: the camera comes back down from the ceiling to the slab

scenes.build: reuse the hall, empty, cooler light; the tag hanging.
scenes.blocking: Clerk enters from the stage right (clerk_in) f104-140 to the clerk mark beside the plinth, faces +z.
scenes.action: f104-140 the clerk walks in; f150-156 his left arm (screen right) reaches the tag's edge, f156 a flick (2 f before 'chưa' f158): the tag spins on its string 1.5 turns, slowing, and stops on its back, CHƯA THANH TOÁN in red, by f182; f196-236 'hệ ma': the tag shivers (2 mm jitter) and fades to a purple see-through ghost, its corners curling like a sheet; f243 'có đó' it hangs; f262 it slips off the string and floats up with a slow S-wobble (0.6 m/s); f278-292 'biến mất' it fades out at y 2.6; the empty string sways. The clerk looks up, shocked.
scenes.acting: Clerk: neutral -> shock on the lift (f262).

cams.why: the plinth next day; the clerk comes in

marks.pose: walks in f104-140; flicks the tag f156; looks up f262

scenes.physics: tag spin: torsion pendulum, 1.5 turns decaying to rest on its back. Ghost: no gravity, rises 0.6 m/s with a sine side-wobble (amplitude 4 cm, 1.2 Hz), fades over 14 f.
scenes.light_mood: the next morning: cooler, dimmer (no crowd).
scenes.sound: footsteps f104-140; a flick tick f156, a spinning whirr; a ghostly theremin 'ooo' f196-290 rising; a soft pop of the string f262; silence after.
scenes.after: The empty string hangs from the arm (it stays until S15).

scenes.vo: Lá Gengar ấy in năm hai nghìn không trăm lẻ hai, bộ Legendary Collection, mặt bóng lấp lánh như pháo hoa, được CGC chấm Pristine mười.
scenes.gloss: That Gengar was printed in 2002, Legendary Collection, its holo face sparkling like fireworks, graded Pristine 10 by CGC.
scenes.viewer: What the card is: 2002, the firework holo, CGC Pristine 10.
scenes.build: reuse the slab (CGC-style, gold PRISTINE 10 label).
scenes.blocking: Clerk gone (walked out of frame during the tilt).
scenes.action: f298-330 the camera comes down onto the slab; f440-470 a white gleam sweeps across the case; f474, f480, f486 three small firework bursts in the dark air beside and behind the slab (left, upper right, right), never over the card, on 'pháo hoa' f477; f515-540 push onto the label; f535 the PRISTINE 10 grade box lights gold on 'Pristine' (f535).
scenes.light_mood: cool; the slab under the plinth light.
scenes.sound: a soft chime per gleam f440; three small firework pops and crackles f474-490; a gold 'ting' f535.

scenes.vo: Ngày mười một tháng mười, trên sàn Fanatics Collect, ba mươi hai lượt trả giá đẩy nó lên năm trăm bảy mươi sáu nghìn.
scenes.gloss: On October 11, on Fanatics Collect, thirty-two bids pushed it up to five hundred seventy-six thousand.
scenes.viewer: The auction: paddle after paddle, the counter to 32, the price to $576,000.
scenes.build: reuse the hall full: three seated bidders with paddles; the bid counter and the price board.
scenes.blocking: Bidders seated on the bidder marks facing +z; auctioneer at the rostrum pointing.
scenes.action: f640-750 32 bids, accelerating: each bid one paddle snaps up (3 f) and down, the counter flips +1 and the board steps up ($200,000 -> $576,000); the last paddle (bidder 2) at f744; f750 the board lands on $576,000 on 'nghìn'; the camera rises to the board f722-752.
scenes.acting: Bidders: stern, then nervous as it climbs; bidder 2 grins on the last bid.
scenes.physics: paddles: 3 f snap up, 2 f hold, 4 f down.
scenes.sound: a rising pizzicato ostinato that speeds up with the bids; a paddle swish + a counter flap per bid; a ka-ching f750.

scenes.vo: Nếu tiền về, đó là kỷ lục mới cho Gengar, vượt xa mức bốn trăm lẻ tám nghìn hồi tháng sáu.
scenes.gloss: If the money arrives, that's a new record for Gengar, far above the four hundred and eight thousand of June.
scenes.viewer: The record pole: $408k (June); the new $576k marker hauled far above it, still a ghost.
scenes.build: new: the record pole with the old brass marker ($408,000 · 06/2026) and the new ghost marker ($576,000, purple see-through) on the pull cord.
scenes.blocking: Clerk at clerk_pole beside the pole (on the stage), facing +z, both arms on the cord.
scenes.action: f790-905 the clerk hauls the cord hand over hand (each pull 14 f): the ghost marker rises from y 1.0 past the old one at 'vượt xa' (f850) to its place, 67 cm above it, by f905; it wobbles once; he wipes his brow (looks up, satisfied).
scenes.acting: Clerk: effort squint, then a proud smile.
scenes.physics: marker: kinematic on the pole, eased per pull, a 1 cm overshoot at the top.
scenes.sound: cord squeaks per pull; a pulley ratchet; a small 'whoa' brass rise f850.
scenes.after: The ghost marker sits 67 cm above $408,000.

scenes.vo: Hai tuần sau, một lá Latios Gold Star, cũng Pristine mười, bán năm trăm lẻ bốn nghìn.
scenes.gloss: Two weeks later, a Latios Gold Star, also Pristine 10, sold for five hundred and four thousand.
scenes.viewer: Same stage, a new lot: the Latios hammers at $504,000.

out.note: push into the Latios slab, dissolve to the census wall

scenes.build: reuse the S01 frame; the Latios slab (real EX Deoxys Latios Gold Star scan, gold PRISTINE 10 label) on the easel; a new SOLD tag in the holder.
scenes.blocking: Auctioneer at the rostrum, gavel raised.
scenes.action: f1062-1092 the board climbs $420,000 -> $504,000; f1084-1090 wind-up, f1094 slam (3 f before 'nghìn' f1097): board $504,000 + SOLD, the new tag drops and swings; f1096-1106 push into the slab.
scenes.acting: Auctioneer grin, squeeze on the slam.

scenes.vo: Trong hơn một trăm bảy mươi lá Latios như thế, nó là lá đẹp nhất.
scenes.gloss: Of more than one hundred seventy Latios like that, it is the finest.
scenes.viewer: A wall of 170 identical slabs; one on the podium is the best.
scenes.build: new: the census gallery: a wall of 170 Latios slabs, the podium with the auction copy, a spotlight.
scenes.action: f1106-1166 the camera trucks along the wall (the rows of slabs pass); f1168-1194 it pulls back to show the podium in front of the wall; f1204 the spotlight snaps on the podium slab on 'đẹp nhất' (f1208), the wall dims 30 %; a gleam crosses the slab f1208-1222.
scenes.light_mood: dark gallery; the spotlight on SPOT7.
scenes.sound: a soft whoosh per row passed; a spotlight 'clunk' f1204; a choir 'aah' f1208.

scenes.vo: Cả thị trường mở sâm panh.
scenes.gloss: The whole market pops the champagne.
scenes.build: reuse the hall's champagne table: four collectors behind it, each with a bottle; a coupe tower.
scenes.blocking: Collectors c1-c4 behind the table on their marks, facing +z, bottles raised at 45 deg in their right arms.
scenes.action: Hard cut on 'Cả' (f1226); f1240-1250 thumbs-less push: the bottles tilt up; f1252 four corks pop together (1 f before 'mở' f1253): corks fly up and back (2-3 m), foam bursts from each neck (fxSplash) for 10 f; the corks hit the floor behind the table, bounce twice and stay; collectors laugh.
scenes.physics: corks: 8 g, launched 4-5 m/s up and back from each neck, gravity, restitution 0.4 on the floor, friction 0.5; they rest and stay (seen in S09 and S14).
scenes.sound: four champagne pops f1252 + fizz; Kids Cheering (meme) f1254; the party theme.
scenes.after: Four corks on the floor; foam on the table.

scenes.vo: Khoan đã, nếu người thắng chưa trả tiền, thì sâm panh này ai trả?
scenes.gloss: Hold on, if the winner hasn't paid, then who pays for this champagne?
scenes.viewer: Freeze. The bill arrives. Everyone points at someone else.
scenes.build: reuse the table; the waiter with a leather bill folder (HÓA ĐƠN · SÂM PANH x4).
scenes.blocking: Waiter walks in from frame right (waiter_in) f1310-1336 to the waiter mark at the table's end.
scenes.action: f1285 'Khoan đã': the music cuts; everyone freezes mid-laugh (the one stillness, 10 f); f1336-1356 the waiter slides the folder onto the table's right end (bill mark), opens it; f1360-1385 collectors' eyes go to the bill; f1391 'ai trả?' (f1393): all four point at another collector with their right arm (c1 -> c2, c2 -> c3, c3 -> c4, c4 -> c1).
scenes.acting: Collectors: laugh -> frozen -> nervous; the waiter: polite smile.

marks.pose: walks in, slides the bill f1336-1356

scenes.physics: the folder: slides 30 cm, stops; opens on its spine.
scenes.light_mood: the party light stays; the music drops out.
scenes.sound: music cut + record stop f1285; Huh (meme) f1287; a paper slide f1340; Suspicious Sound (meme) f1393.
scenes.after: The bill lies open on the table; corks on the floor.

scenes.vo: Bạn thấy đấy, giá đấu giá giống câu "mai tao trả" của thằng bạn vay tiền.
scenes.gloss: You see, an auction price is like 'I'll pay you tomorrow' from a friend who borrowed money.
scenes.viewer: A friend pockets borrowed cash and slides over a promise, a ghost note.
scenes.build: new: the café terrace, round table, two coffees; a fan of banknotes; the IOU note (ghost purple, see-through).
scenes.blocking: Borrower seated at the borrower mark (screen left), lender at the lender mark; both face +z.
scenes.action: f1412-1468 the borrower fans the cash and grins; f1470-1484 he tucks it into his hoodie; f1490-1508 his left arm slides the IOU 'MAI TAO TRẢ' across to the middle on 'mai tao trả' (f1495-1510): it is see-through purple and hovers 2 cm above the table, wobbling like a ghost; f1520-1550 push onto the note.
scenes.acting: Borrower: big grin; lender: flat, unconvinced.

marks.pose: seated; cash fan, tucks it, slides the IOU f1490-1508

scenes.physics: the note: kinematic slide, then a ghost hover (2 cm, 1 Hz bob).
scenes.light_mood: golden late afternoon, long warm light.
scenes.sound: street ambience, a café clink; a calm guitar-like pluck theme; a paper slide f1490; a ghostly 'ooo' (soft) f1508.
scenes.after: The ghost note sits between them.

scenes.vo: Nghe rất to, rất chắc, nhưng phải đến khi tiền thật sự chuyển đi, lời hứa mới thành giá thật.
scenes.gloss: It sounds very loud, very sure, but only when the money actually moves does the promise become a real price.
scenes.viewer: Loud and sure means nothing; the money crosses the table and the promise turns real.
scenes.build: new: a red megaphone (held), the cash envelope; the green ĐÃ TRẢ stamp.
scenes.action: f1548-1553 he lifts the megaphone; f1555-1580 'rất to': he shouts into it: sound rings burst from the bell, the two cups hop 2 cm and rattle, the lender leans back; f1586-1590 'rất chắc': he slams the table with his right arm (contact f1590): cups hop again, the ghost note just wobbles (no weight); f1636-1668 'tiền thật sự chuyển đi': his left arm slides the fat cash envelope across the table to the lender's side (45 cm), it stops at her arm; f1675-1700 'lời hứa': the note settles flat onto the table and fills from see-through purple to solid white paper; f1707 the green stamp ĐÃ TRẢ thunks onto it on 'giá thật' (f1709); the lender smiles.
scenes.acting: Borrower: loud grin -> earnest; lender: stern -> smile at the stamp.

marks.pose: megaphone f1553-1580, thump f1590, envelope f1636-1668
seated; leans back f1560; takes the envelope

scenes.physics: cups: hop 2 cm (rattle) on each shout pulse and on the thump; the envelope: a kinematic slide with friction, stops dead.
scenes.sound: megaphone feedback + a distorted shout bed f1555-1580 (under the VO); a table thump f1590 with a cup rattle; an envelope slide f1640; a solid paper 'fwump' f1690; Kaching (meme) on the stamp f1707.
scenes.after: The note is solid with ĐÃ TRẢ; the envelope is on her side.

scenes.vo: Ngay trên sàn này, một trang tin vừa phát hiện hàng triệu đô kết quả Pokémon đã lặng lẽ biến khỏi lịch sử bán, vì không nhận được tiền.
scenes.gloss: On this very platform, a news site just discovered millions of dollars of Pokémon results had quietly disappeared from the sales history, because the money never came.
scenes.viewer: A writer watches sale after sale ghost off the sales history; the missing total climbs into the millions.
scenes.build: new: the writer's desk at night (laptop, lamp, mug); the laptop page FANATICS COLLECT · LỊCH SỬ BÁN: 8 rows (real card thumbnails, price, date, ĐÃ BÁN), a counter 'ĐÃ BIẾN MẤT'.
scenes.blocking: Writer seated at the writer mark facing +z, lit by the screen.
scenes.action: f1728-1790 the writer leans in to the laptop; f1790-1818 into his POV; f1840-1945 'lặng lẽ biến khỏi lịch sử bán': rows 2, 5, 3, 7, 6 turn purple see-through and float up off the page one after another (every 16 f), each leaving a grey line KHÔNG NHẬN ĐƯỢC TIỀN on 'vì không nhận được tiền' (f1913); the counter at the bottom climbs $0 -> $3,4xx,xxx ('hàng triệu đô' f1804).
scenes.light_mood: night: the room dim, the screen glow.
scenes.sound: keyboard clicks; a soft 'whoosh' per ghosted row; Computer Error Sound (meme) on 'không nhận được tiền' f1913; a low drone.
scenes.after: The page has five grey gaps.

scenes.vo: Fanatics nói làm vậy để thông tin thị trường được chính xác.
scenes.gloss: Fanatics says it does this so the market information is accurate.
scenes.viewer: The spokesman blanks the price board: accurate.
scenes.build: reuse the rostrum and the price board; a big green button on the rostrum; a CHÍNH XÁC lamp under the board.
scenes.blocking: Spokesman behind the rostrum (auct mark), facing +z.
scenes.action: f1957-2020 the board shows $576,000 SOLD; the spokesman talks; f2026-2030 his right arm presses the button (contact f2030, 2 f before 'chính xác' f2032): the board clears to '—', the CHÍNH XÁC lamp lights green; he smiles.
scenes.sound: a button clunk f2030, the board's clack and a clean 'ding' f2032.
scenes.after: The board is blank; CHÍNH XÁC lit.

scenes.vo: Nên bây giờ, mỗi khi thấy một con số khổng lồ, dân sưu tầm làm thêm một việc trước khi mở sâm panh: mở trang lịch sử bán, và tìm hai chữ, đã trả.
scenes.gloss: So now, whenever they see a giant number, collectors do one more thing before popping the champagne: open the sales history page and look for two words: paid.
scenes.viewer: A collector sees a giant number, stops before popping, checks the sales history for ĐÃ TRẢ, then pops.
scenes.build: reuse the champagne table (the corks still on the floor, empty coupes); c1 (green hoodie) with a bottle and his phone (canvas: FANATICS COLLECT · LỊCH SỬ BÁN, a row with a green ĐÃ TRẢ badge).
scenes.blocking: c1 behind the table at c1_late, facing +z.
scenes.action: f2100 the price board (behind him, far) flips to $1,000,000 on 'con số khổng lồ' (f2107-2123); f2130-2150 he raises the bottle to pop; f2183-2200 'trước khi mở sâm panh' he stops and sets it on the table; f2206-2220 his left arm brings up his phone; f2222-2296 his POV: the sales history page, he scrolls to the $1,000,000 row and finds the green ĐÃ TRẢ badge stamping on at f2294 ('đã trả'); f2298-2310 back out; f2312 he pops the cork (contact f2312): it flies, foam, it lands by the old corks.

marks.pose: bottle up f2130, down f2190, phone f2206, pop f2312

scenes.sound: a ka-ching f2104 (the giant number); a hesitant pluck f2186; phone taps; Mobile Payment (meme) on ĐÃ TRẢ f2294; a pop + fizz f2312.

scenes.viewer: The Gengar slab alone at night, its printed grin; the ghost tag drifts by.
scenes.build: reuse the plinth: the Gengar slab back on the easel (it came back unpaid), the empty tag string; a spotlight; the ghost tag.
scenes.action: f2326-2420 slow push into the card's art (Gengar's grin); f2340-2405 the ghost tag drifts across behind the slab from left to right, fading; end on the grin.
scenes.physics: the ghost: no gravity, sine drift.
scenes.light_mood: night: the hall dark, one spotlight on the plinth.
scenes.sound: Hehe Boiiiiiii (meme, soft) f2384; the theme's last note.
